releases.name: Warrior Spirits
releases.summary: A martial arts card battler inspired by one of my favorite childhood games. Experience a story-driven adventure, level up your fighters, build your deck, shape your playstyle with stat upgrades, conquer roguelike runs, battle Raid Bosses, and fight players around the world in online pvp.

releases.name: Mireglow
releases.summary: Step into a peaceful mystical swamp filled with wonder and hidden discoveries.

releases.name: Blocky Powers
releases.summary:
BLOCKY POWERS is a block-stacking game that combines realistic physics with 2-player local multiplayer. Build the tallest and most stable tower with your friends and enjoy an exciting competition! 

You can't win just by stacking blocks. Every block is affected by weight and balance and will sway. Furthermore, strong winds will hit your tower, and even a small mistake will lead to collapse.

releases.name: The Escape From Dungeon Keep
releases.summary: A classic text RPG: type commands to explore, fight turn-based battles, manage inventory, upgrade gear, and finish side quests. Chase multiple endings, New Game+ content, achievements, and moddable Workshop maps.

releases.name: Horror Prison: Escape
releases.summary: You're not alone.

releases.name: Chaotic World
releases.summary: Chaotic World is a top-down PvE arena shooter where your objective is to clear waves of different and unique enemies until you destroy them all. Set across colorful maps, you will have the opportunity to make yourself stronger by leveling up and finding loot on your way to the last wave!

releases.name: NEON SURGE
releases.summary: A fast, neon twin-stick arena shooter: you aim, your ship auto-fires. Dash through bullets, hold off ever-bigger waves and pick roguelite upgrades each wave. 8 ships, 10 worlds, 7 modes.

releases.name: I CAN'T STOP WINNING!
releases.summary: A 2D blackjack inspired rogue-lite game for addicts and winners

releases.name: Puzzle Loot
releases.summary: A 7×7 tap puzzle roguelite RPG. Clear blocks to defeat monsters, choose from 12 classes, collect gear, and reincarnate again and again as you climb toward the Demon Lord's Castle. Easy to pick up, deep enough to master, with a bounty system that changes how you play.

releases.name: Sweetie Candy Maze: Azure Honeyberry
releases.summary: Dive into a vibrant candy world! Collect delicious sweets and find your way through playful azure honeyberry mazes in this sweet and colorful adventure.

releases.name: The Expansion
releases.summary: A psychological first-person horror experience set in endless Backrooms. Explore abandoned corridors, uncover hidden secrets, evade mysterious entities, and survive a world where every turn leads deeper into the unknown.

releases.name: A Dragon's Tale
releases.summary: An exciting reverse Tower Defense! Defend the tower from hordes of civilians, strategically place your monsters, and take on the challenge across 3 unique modes: Story, Hardcore, and Infinity.

releases.name: Ashfire Keep
releases.summary: Defend a besieged keep against ever-growing waves of enemies: fight in melee or at range, build towers and manage supplies, and grow stronger run after run in this action defense roguelite.

releases.name: ONE MORE FISHING
releases.summary: One More Fishing is an atmospheric fishing simulator inspired by classic browser games. Cast your line, choose your tackle and bait, discover new fishing spots, and build your own collection of fish. Take a little break by the water — any day of the week.

releases.name: Two-Dye
releases.summary: Two-Dye is a small indie game where you and your friends (or other people online) can Paint, Hide & Seek in a 2D world.

releases.name: Simple Airline Sim
releases.summary: A minimalistic airline management game where you buy planes, choose routes and try to stay ahead of the competition.

releases.name: Mall: Tidy Up Together
releases.summary: Shelve the products, unlock new skills, and use your unique methods to tidy up the mall. Enjoy the online co-op and online PvP with your friends, or go solo! Fill up the shelves and experience a sense of relief and satisfaction.

releases.name: The Last Portal
releases.summary: Build and upgrade a fantasy army to defend the last surviving portal across 150 increasingly dangerous waves, expanding zones, and powerful boss battles.

releases.name: Alice ou o Mundo?
releases.summary: A fantasy turn-based RPG where a young mercenary embarks on a journey to save his sister, Alice. Explore diverse regions, battle corrupted creatures, recruit unique allies, complete side quests, and shape the fate of the world through your choices.

releases.name: Make Her Real
releases.summary: A young inmate is given a faded body pillow of a girl from an old romance VN. Then she starts speaking... and becomes the only person who still sees him as human. A short psychological horror VN about isolation, guilt, parasocial comfort, and the terror of choosing freedom.
